[FMLA 15] SimpPendulum — Cycle of Simple Pendulum

Period of a simple pendulum for small angles.

Calculator scroll name: SimpPendulum. Period of a simple pendulum for small angles.

formula
T=2πgL​​

A longer playground swing takes longer to come back. That is T = 2π L/g​. The dashed positions are the ends of a small arc.

keys
FMLA→1→5

Primary inputs: L.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 5 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 1 → 5
  2. Enter length L
  3. Pendulum period
note

Small-angle period. Uses g from ROM. Enter length L in metres (L > 0); T is in seconds.
